Most dramatically, Daniel 5:26 announces God's verdict on Belshazzar: 'God has numbered your kingdom and finished it'—brought it to its divinely appointed end. The root connects to the broader Semitic family of words about wholeness and completion, but here emphasizes definitive conclusion or full delivery."
